          - default

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v4

  deploy:

      - name: Checkout code

        uses: actions/setup-python@v5

          python-version: '3.13'

        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v4

      - name: Install AWS SAM CLI
        uses: aws-actions/setup-sam@v2

      - name: Configure AWS credentials (OIDC)

        id: config
